`final class Packer`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.tool.msdf.atlas` · **Module:** `tool-msdf` · **Source:** [Packer.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/tool/msdf/src/main/java/dev/joid/tool/msdf/atlas/Packer.java)

Places the glyphs of an atlas in rows and finds the largest glyph size that fits.

- [MSDF text](/use/in-depth/msdf-text/)

## Method details

<a id="Packer-method-pack"></a>

### pack

`boolean pack(List<GlyphEntry> glyphs, double size, double range, int width, int height)` <span class="joid-qualifier">static</span>

Measures and places every drawable glyph at that size, tallest first, with one pixel between glyphs; returns `false` when they do not fit in the atlas.

<a id="Packer-method-fit"></a>

### fit

`double fit(List<GlyphEntry> glyphs, double range, int width, int height)` <span class="joid-qualifier">static</span>

**Throws:**

- `IllegalStateException`: The glyphs do not fit in …x… even at …px, raise --width and --height or shrink the charset

Returns the largest size, to a sixteenth of a pixel, at which the glyphs fit, and leaves them placed at it.
Throws an `IllegalStateException` when they do not fit even at 1 pixel.
